title: AgentFlow — Journeys
description: Paste a case/loop/run id; open a trace_id in Traces.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp, serviceName, name, round(duration_nano / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, has_error, status_message, attributes_string['af.error.reason'] AS error_reason, trace_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR resources_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR resources_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR resources_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(timestamp)) AS time, resources_string['service.name'] AS service, attributes_string['event.name'] AS event, severity_text, body, trace_id FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR resources_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR resources_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR resources_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp, serviceName, name, status_message, attributes_string['af.error.reason'] AS error_reason, trace_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE has_error = true AND (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR resources_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR resources_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR resources_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT trace_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, argMin(name, timestamp) AS root_span FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR resources_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR resources_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR resources_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY first_seen LIMIT 100

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(timestamp)) AS time, resources_string['af.case_id'] AS case_id, resources_string['af.loop_id'] AS loop_id, replaceOne(attributes_string['event.name'], 'claude_code.', '') AS event, attributes_string['tool_name'] AS tool_name, attributes_string['success'] AS success, coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['error'], ''), attributes_string['status_code']) AS reason, attributes_string['model'] AS model, attributes_number['cost_usd'] AS cost_usd, attributes_number['input_tokens'] AS input_tokens, attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, trace_id FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE resources_string['service.name'] = 'af-claude-code' AND replaceOne(attributes_string['event.name'], 'claude_code.', '') IN ('api_error', 'tool_result', 'api_request') AND (resources_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (resources_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (resources_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY (replaceOne(attributes_string['event.name'], 'claude_code.', '') = 'api_error' OR (replaceOne(attributes_string['event.name'], 'claude_code.', '') = 'tool_result' AND attributes_string['success'] = 'false')) DESC, timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

widgets.title: Claude Code tokens / cost per case

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(ts.labels, 'af.case_id') AS case_id, JSONExtractString(ts.labels, 'af.loop_id') AS loop_id, sumIf(s.value, ts.metric_name LIKE 'claude_code%cost%') AS cost_usd, sumIf(s.value, ts.metric_name LIKE 'claude_code%token%') AS tokens FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, metric_name, labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE (metric_name LIKE 'claude_code%cost%' OR metric_name LIKE 'claude_code%token%') AND unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} - 3600000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS ts ON s.fingerprint = ts.fingerprint WHERE s.unix_milli BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_ms}} AND {{.end_timestamp_ms}} AND (JSONExtractString(ts.labels, 'af.case_id') = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') GROUP BY case_id, loop_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 200
